description: For material delivery, this inspection checklist records expected quantities, unloading plan, inspection criteria, documentation, protected storage, and installation need date. Its supporting evidence includes packing slip, count, condition photos, certificate, temperature or moisture reading, and discrepancy notice.

title: Material Delivery Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during material delivery receipt and condition control when the material delivery record must identify purchase order, supplier, carrier, delivery location, product identifiers, lot numbers, and storage requirements. Complete the applicable handoff for accepted quantity, shortage or damage claim, inventory location, responsible custodian, and procurement update.
